The composition must be straight-on, centrally framed, emphasizing the elongated, interwoven body filling the entire frame. **Narrative Focus:**
The image is a visual pun, exaggerating the dachshund's length to create an abstract, decorative knot pattern, seamlessly blending the animal form with complex abstract design. The dog should be presented as a static, decorative element.
